description: This PHP class 'Forgotten' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Mail' handles the process of generating and queuing an email for password reset functionality within the admin panel of an OpenCart-based system. The 'index' method checks input parameters, retrieves user information, prepares email content, and schedules an email task.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Handles the process of sending a password reset email for a user within the admin area of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that processes password reset requests: validates input, retrieves user info, prepares email content, and queues email task.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the password reset email creation and task scheduling.
